name: Golden Pride

features.name: Expanding lion wild
features.description: Expands to fill its reel when it lands.

features.name: Progressive respins
features.description: Non-winning respins raise a multiplier that can reach 1,024x.

review:
Golden Pride is a 5x3, 243-ways slot where a lion king defends his pride. The lion wild expands to cover its whole reel whenever it appears, helping to complete wins.

If the expanded lion doesn't help form a win, it starts a respin round instead. Each non-winning respin increases a progressive multiplier, which can reach 1,024x in this bonus challenge, so a long sequence without wins builds towards a large multiplied payout. BGaming rates the game medium-high volatility and lists a maximum multiplier of 15,360x. The RTP is 96%. The respin mechanic is an inventive twist: a miss in the base game sets up the bonus rather than wasting the wild.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
